# Observer Patch Holography Papers

Release: r2034
Released: September 2, 2026

This page lists the first-party HTML and PDF URLs for the OPH paper stack.

## Deriving Standard Model Gauge Structure from Observer Overlap Consistency

- HTML: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/standard-model-gauge-structure/
- PDF: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/standard-model-gauge-structure/paper.pdf
- Authors: Bernhard Mueller, Alexander Osika, Mario Poneder, Kai Xue, Peter Nguyen, David Matscheko
- Affiliations: Bernhard Mueller, Pragma Research Inc.; Alexander Osika, EtherWorks
- Category: Gauge structure
- Summary: Examines two mathematical routes from observer overlap to the symmetry structure used by the Standard Model. The physical identification of that structure is an open question.

## Deriving the Particle Zoo from Observer Consistency

- HTML: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/particle-spectrum-from-observer-consistency/
- PDF: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/particle-spectrum-from-observer-consistency/paper.pdf
- Authors: Bernhard Mueller, Alexander Osika, Mario Poneder, Kai Xue
- Affiliations: Bernhard Mueller, Pragma Research Inc.; Alexander Osika, EtherWorks
- Category: Particles
- Summary: Explores whether the observer-consistency framework can account for particles and physical constants. Several comparisons are mathematical or conditional, and their connection to measured physics remains open.

## Finite Observer Consensus as a Reconstruction Principle: Normal Forms, the Standard Model Lie Type, and a Route to the Einstein Field Equation

- HTML: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/from-observer-consensus-to-standard-physics/
- PDF: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/from-observer-consensus-to-standard-physics/paper.pdf
- Authors: Bernhard Mueller, Alexander Osika, Mario Poneder, Kai Xue, Ben Cassie, Peter Nguyen, Jinwook Kim, David Matscheko, Jonathan Hill, William T. Glynn, Maarten Antoine Visser, Kale Arnav Anirudha
- Affiliations: Bernhard Mueller, Pragma Research Inc.; Alexander Osika, EtherWorks
- Category: Flagship reconstruction paper
- Summary: The flagship technical account of Observer Patch Holography. It develops finite consensus normal forms, Standard Model Lie-type reconstruction, and a conditional route to the Einstein field equation, with the physical identification steps stated separately.

## Observers Are All You Need

- HTML: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/observers-are-all-you-need/
- PDF: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/observers-are-all-you-need/paper.pdf
- Authors: Bernhard Mueller, Alexander Osika, Mario Poneder, Kai Xue, Ben Cassie, Peter Nguyen
- Affiliations: Bernhard Mueller, Pragma Research Inc.; Alexander Osika, EtherWorks
- Category: Observer-first synthesis
- Summary: A compact synthesis of Observer Patch Holography: finite observer repair, a source-derived informational poset, the exact rank-three signed-record carrier, and conditional routes to Lorentzian gravity and Standard Model structure, with the remaining physical attachments stated explicitly.

## Paradise as Fixed-Point Consensus

- HTML: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/paradise-as-fixed-point-consensus/
- PDF: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/paradise-as-fixed-point-consensus/paper.pdf
- Authors: Bernhard Mueller
- Affiliations: Bernhard Mueller, Pragma Research Inc.
- Category: Observer continuation
- Summary: The OPH continuation and meaning paper. It reads existence, observer continuation, record consistency, justice, resurrection, and paradise through fixed-point consensus.

## Reality as a Consensus Protocol

- HTML: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/reality-as-consensus-protocol/
- PDF: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/reality-as-consensus-protocol/paper.pdf
- Authors: Bernhard Mueller, Kai Xue, Jinwook Kim, Kale Arnav Anirudha, David Matscheko, Jonathan Hill
- Affiliations: Bernhard Mueller, Pragma Research Inc.
- Category: Simulation theory
- Summary: Develops the mathematics of shared records, disagreement repair, and stable outcomes among limited observers.

## Recovering Observer Spacetime and Einstein Dynamics from Overlap Consistency

- HTML: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/observer-spacetime-einstein-dynamics/
- PDF: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/observer-spacetime-einstein-dynamics/paper.pdf
- Authors: Bernhard Mueller, Alexander Osika, Mario Poneder, Kai Xue, Peter Nguyen, Maarten Antoine Visser, David Matscheko
- Affiliations: Bernhard Mueller, Pragma Research Inc.; Alexander Osika, EtherWorks
- Category: Gravity
- Summary: Explores how shared observer records could lead to spacetime and gravity. The paper states the mathematical results and the conditions needed to connect them to physical gravity.

## Screen Microphysics and Observer Synchronization

- HTML: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/screen-microphysics-and-observer-synchronization/
- PDF: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/screen-microphysics-and-observer-synchronization/paper.pdf
- Authors: Bernhard Mueller, Alexander Osika, Kai Xue, Ben Cassie
- Affiliations: Bernhard Mueller, Pragma Research Inc.; Alexander Osika, EtherWorks
- Category: Screen physics
- Summary: Studies a finite observer model with records, synchronization, measurement, and possible hardware evidence. It separates mathematical results from open questions about their physical realization.

## Photonic Fixed-Point Consensus for SHA-256d Proof of Work

- HTML: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/photonic-fixed-point-consensus-sha256d-proof-of-work/
- PDF: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/photonic-fixed-point-consensus-sha256d-proof-of-work/paper.pdf
- Authors: Bernhard Mueller, Alexander Osika
- Affiliations: Bernhard Mueller, Pragma Research Inc.; Alexander Osika, EtherWorks
- Category: Physical computation
- Summary: An OPH-adjacent physical-computation paper on photonic fixed-point consensus, SHA-256d proof of work, analog constraint satisfaction, and verifier receipts.

## The de Sitter Time-Advance Sign from a Finite Screen with Fixed Capacity

- HTML: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/de-sitter-time-advance-fixed-screen-capacity/
- PDF: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/de-sitter-time-advance-fixed-screen-capacity/paper.pdf
- Authors: Bernhard Mueller
- Affiliations: Bernhard Mueller, Pragma Research Inc.
- Category: de Sitter physics
- Summary: Derives finite entropy, capacity-transfer, analytic-curvature, and graph-spectrum identities that conditionally reproduce the de Sitter time-advance sign. The gravitational shock dictionary and coefficient remain separate physical inputs.

## The Fine-Structure Constant as an OPH Pixel Fixed Point

- HTML: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/fine-structure-constant-oph-pixel-fixed-point/
- PDF: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/fine-structure-constant-oph-pixel-fixed-point/paper.pdf
- Authors: Bernhard Mueller, Alexander Osika
- Affiliations: Bernhard Mueller, Pragma Research Inc.; Alexander Osika, EtherWorks
- Category: Constants
- Summary: A focused OPH paper on the fine-structure constant, local screen-cell closure, hadronic endpoint transport, and the fixed-point status of alpha.

## The Positive-Chamber Koide Identity for Icosahedral Face Circulants

- HTML: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/positive-chamber-koide-icosahedral-face-circulants/
- PDF: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/positive-chamber-koide-icosahedral-face-circulants/paper.pdf
- Authors: Bernhard Mueller
- Affiliations: Bernhard Mueller, Pragma Research Inc.
- Category: Flavor structure
- Summary: Proves the exact Koide invariant for positive Hermitian C3 face circulants and isolates the balance condition that yields Q = 2/3. The finite GNS implication and tau-mass window are conditional; no physical lepton-family attachment or source-only mass prediction is claimed.

## Machine-Checked Finite Event Algebras for Observer-Patch Holography

- HTML: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/machine-checked-finite-event-algebras/
- PDF: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/machine-checked-finite-event-algebras/paper.pdf
- Authors: Bernhard Mueller
- Affiliations: Bernhard Mueller, Pragma Research Inc.
- Category: Mathematical foundations
- Summary: A machine-checked finite-event-algebra paper for OPH measurement surfaces, including Boolean event structure, traces, conditional expectations, and Born-Luders update rules.

## Observation-Determined Normal Forms: Stability, Obstructions, and Refinement in Constraint and Rewrite Systems

- HTML: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/observation-determined-normal-forms/
- PDF: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/observation-determined-normal-forms/paper.pdf
- Authors: Bernhard Mueller, Jinwook Kim, David Matscheko, Jonathan Hill
- Affiliations: Bernhard Mueller, Pragma Research Inc.
- Category: Mathematical foundations
- Summary: A substrate-neutral mathematical paper separating same-source confluence, cross-source identification from protected observations, liveness, and local repairability, with quantitative stability and refinement criteria.
